title: Background Sync
description: Implement background sync strategies for offline mutations and data consistency in React Query.

data.text: When a user submits a form while offline, the mutation fails. Background sync solves this by queueing the mutation locally and replaying it when connectivity returns. React Query does not have built-in offline mutation queuing, but you can implement it with a combination of local storage and network listeners.
Store failed mutations in IndexedDB or localStorage with a unique ID, timestamp, and payload. When the app detects it is back online, replay the queue in order.

data.title: Offline mutation queue pattern

data.text: Always deduplicate queued mutations by ID. If the user adds the same todo twice while offline, replaying the queue should not create duplicates.
data.title: Deduplication
Background Sync Key Points
points: Replay queue in order when connectivity returns.
Use IndexedDB for larger mutation histories.
Combine with optimistic updates for perceived performance.
data.takeaway: Background sync makes React Query applications resilient to network interruptions.
